text: Took my usual GERD meds with breakfast. Oatmeal and a banana – trying to keep it bland today.
Did my quick 15-minute meditation. Feeling a little more centered before diving into work.
Quick check-in with Panda before heading to the home office. She's working from home today too.
Reflecting on the day, I felt productive at work and enjoyed spending time with Panda. Overall, a good day.
Started the day by reviewing the K0 system logs. Still seeing those intermittent errors. Need to figure out the root cause.
Had a quick sync with Sharvi about the K1 API integration. She's making good progress.
Spent an hour debugging the K0 error. Narrowed it down to a potential memory leak in one of the modules.
Wrote a quick script to monitor memory usage in that module. Hopefully, this will give me more insight.
Reviewed Aarav's PR for the new K1 feature. Left a few comments.
Need to remember to follow up with Aarav about those comments tomorrow.
Quick lunch break. Had a sandwich at my desk.
Back to debugging the K0 memory leak. The monitoring script is showing some interesting patterns.
Implemented a potential fix for the memory leak. Pushed it to the test environment.
Spent some time writing unit tests for the K0 fix.
Had a call with the team to discuss the K0/K1 roadmap. Lots of exciting things coming up.
Reviewed the latest K1 documentation. Need to make sure I'm up-to-date on all the changes.
Committed the unit tests and updated documentation.
Hit the gym for a quick workout. Focused on cardio today.
Felt good to get some exercise in. Head starting to feel a little better too.
Made dinner with Panda. We had pasta with pesto. It was delicious!
Watched a movie with Panda after dinner. We saw the new sci-fi film, it was pretty good.
Called Mom and Dad. They're doing well. Dadi sends her love. Nana is still gardening.
Played some video games online with friends.
Winding down for the night. Thinking about the K0 memory leak – hopefully, the fix works in the test environment.
Woke up feeling somewhat refreshed, though my GERD is acting up a bit this morning. Sleep quality was maybe a 7/10. Also, my nose is a little stuffy. Time for my morning routine.
Read a few chapters of my book before bed. Currently reading a biography of Ada Lovelace.
Set my alarm and got ready for bed. Hoping for a good night's sleep.
